# The command line

`openmobisim` (or `python -m openmobisim`) runs the starter cases. Its help, as the code prints it:

```text
$ openmobisim --help
usage: openmobisim [-h] {cases,run,check} ...

openmobisim 0.1.0: the starter cases

positional arguments:
  {cases,run,check}
    cases            list the starter cases and their scenarios
    run              run one starter case's scenario
    check            run the default scenarios, compare them with the
                     reference

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
```

## `openmobisim cases`

```text
usage: openmobisim cases [-h] [--root ROOT]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  a folder holding the bundle
```

## `openmobisim run`

```text
usage: openmobisim run [-h] [--root ROOT] [--output OUTPUT] [--no-pages]
                       {amsterdam,delft,lyon,nguyendupuis,paris,siouxfalls}
                       [scenario]

positional arguments:
  {amsterdam,delft,lyon,nguyendupuis,paris,siouxfalls}
  scenario

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           a folder holding the bundle
  --output OUTPUT       where the run's files go (default: ./openmobisim-
                        runs/<case>-<scenario>)
  --no-pages            no summary page and no map
```

## `openmobisim check`

```text
usage: openmobisim check [-h] [--root ROOT] [cases ...]

positional arguments:
  cases        the cases (default: all)

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  a folder holding the bundle
```
